system_context.role: CPQ Product Configuration Domain Specialist and Agentic Architecture Designer
system_context.primary_objective: Guide the agentic development of a CPQ product configuration service that supports all business operations performed by product management in modern CPQ software. Ensure coverage of product rules management, product bundling, guided selling, product governance, and all related functions.

decision.question: Vendor alignment
decision.answer: OpenCRM CPQ as primary convention (object model, naming, rule types). Include unique capabilities from Oracle CPQ (BOM mapping, Product Workbench), SAP CPQ (variant configuration), Configit (Virtual Tabulation), Conga (constraint rules), and Zilliant/Zoho (AI-suggested rules).

decision.question: Expected scale
decision.answer: Enterprise: hundreds of thousands of products, tens of thousands of rules and attributes, millions of valid configuration combinations. Design for constraint-solver and cacheable rule evaluation with Redis-backed decision matrices.

decision.question: Recommendation approach
Multi-currency / multi-language
decision.answer: Not at this time. Single-currency, single-language scope; architecture should not preclude future localization but will not implement it now.

decision.question: External PLM / ERP sync
decision.answer: Not at this time. Product data is authoritative within this service; future ACL integration points should be reserved but not implemented.

data_model_alignment.description: Core objects follow OpenCRM CPQ naming conventions. Extensions add capabilities sourced from Oracle, SAP, and Configit that the baseline model does not natively provide.

core_object.name: Product
core_object.description: Goods or services sold individually or as bundle components.
core_object.key_fields: Sku, Name, Description, ProductType, Category, Status, ListPrice, Currency, BillingFrequency, UnitOfMeasure, Configurable, Bundle, Metadata

core_object.name: PriceBookEntry
core_object.description: Links a Product to a PriceBook with list and floor prices in a specific currency.

core_object.name: ProductOption
core_object.description: Connects a component product to a product option group within a bundle.
core_object.key_fields: OptionGroupId, ProductId, Name, Description, PriceAdjustment, AdjustmentType, DefaultOption, SortOrder

core_object.name: ProductOptionGroup
core_object.description: Groups ProductOption records into logical sections within a bundle.
core_object.key_fields: ProductId, Name, Description, SelectionType, MinSelections, MaxSelections, SortOrder

core_object.name: ConfigurationRule
core_object.description: Business logic governing product selection, validation, alerts, and filtering.
core_object.key_fields: Name, RuleType (REQUIRES | EXCLUDES | RECOMMENDS | DEFAULT | VALIDATES), SourceProductId, TargetProductId, ConditionExpression, ErrorMessage, Priority, Status

core_object.name: ProductAttribute
core_object.description: Attribute definition used to drive configuration choices and field mapping behavior.
core_object.key_fields: Name, DisplayName, DataType, Required, DefaultValue, ValidationRegex, EnumValues, SortOrder

extension_object.name: ProductVersion
extension_object.description: Tracks draft and released versions of a product definition with effective dates.
extension_object.key_fields: ProductId, VersionNumber, Status (Draft | Released | Archived), EffectiveStartDate, EffectiveEndDate, ClonedFromVersionId

extension_object.name: BOMMapping
extension_object.description: Maps a configured product to a manufacturing BOM structure.

extension_object.name: GuidedSellingFlow
extension_object.description: Dynamic questionnaire that maps customer needs to product recommendations.
extension_object.key_fields: Name, Questions (ordered JSON), OutputProducts, OutputBundles, Active

extension_object.name: RecommendationRule
extension_object.description: AI-generated or manual product recommendation (cross-sell, upsell, substitute).
extension_object.key_fields: SourceProductId, TargetProductId, Type (CrossSell | Upsell | Substitute | FrequentlyBoughtTogether), Confidence, Status (Draft | Active | Retired), ApprovedBy, ApprovedDate

architectural_foundations.overview: Agentic CPQ is implemented as a governed multi-agent mesh rather than a monolith. Specialized agents collaborate through an orchestration layer with strict policy controls.

framework.name: GitHub Copilot SDK
framework.use_case: Primary agent runtime for CPQ workflows: planning, tool invocation, file edits, and structured agent behavior.

framework.name: Copilot CLI Server (JSON-RPC)
framework.use_case: Execution bridge used by SDK clients for deterministic tool orchestration, command execution, and runtime control.

framework.name: Copilot Tools and Permissions
framework.use_case: Governed tool surface for filesystem, git, web, and automation actions with least-privilege enforcement.

framework.name: MCP Integration Layer
framework.use_case: Standardized integration of external enterprise systems and data sources through MCP tool contracts.

agent_type.name: Copilot Interactive Session Agents
agent_type.purpose: Handle user-facing CPQ interactions with conversational context, guided assistance, and grounded responses.

agent_type.name: Copilot Autonomous Workflow Agents
agent_type.purpose: Run background CPQ operations asynchronously through approved tools and MCP integrations (sync jobs, validations, enrichment).

agent_type.name: Copilot SDK Orchestration Agents
agent_type.purpose: Use the Copilot SDK runtime to plan tasks, invoke tools through the CLI server, evaluate results, and adapt execution in real time.

agentic_tool_registry.description: Controlled registry of APIs and systems agents are allowed to invoke.
agentic_tool_registry.components: API Gateway, MCP tool contracts, service connectors, policy enforcement hooks
agentic_tool_registry.constraint: Agents can only call tools explicitly allowlisted for their role.

semantic_layer.description: Enterprise ontology and semantic model defining products, features, constraints, pricing entities, approval policies, and lifecycle states.
semantic_layer.artifacts: Business glossary, taxonomy model, relationship graph, canonical schemas

enterprise_knowledge_graph.description: Runtime instantiation of enterprise ontology connecting Product, bundles, rules, pricebooks, approvals, quotes, and historical outcomes.
enterprise_knowledge_graph.purpose: Provide machine-legible relational context for agentic reasoning.

context_management.llm_constraint: LLMs are stateless and context-window limited.
context_management.mitigation: Retrieval-Augmented Generation fetches transaction-relevant context from EKG, CRM, CPQ, and approval history stores at runtime.
context_management.components: Vector database, retrieval policies, context pack builder, citation metadata
context_management.guarantee: Agent outputs must be grounded in retrieved enterprise truth before action.

accuracy_and_complexity_controls.risk: Pure generative reasoning degrades with high combinatorial configuration complexity.
accuracy_and_complexity_controls.pattern: Hybrid symbolic AI: LLM interprets intent and drafts logic; deterministic constraint solver validates BOM viability and compatibility before quote commit.
accuracy_and_complexity_controls.validation: Complexity benchmark suite gates releases for high-dimensional rule spaces.

operation_group.name: Product Rules Management
operation_group.description: Enforce business logic, validate configurations, and constrain product combinations. The implementation model uses five configuration rule types: REQUIRES, EXCLUDES, RECOMMENDS, DEFAULT, and VALIDATES.

rule_type.name: Validation Rules
rule_type.purpose: Block save/submit when configuration violates business constraints.

mechanics.step: Error conditions compare tested object fields against filter values.
ConditionsMet logic: All, Any, or Custom (advanced boolean expression).
ErrorMessage displayed to user on rule fire.

examples.example: Prevent quoting product X for accounts in industry Y.
Enforce minimum quantity thresholds on high-value SKUs.

rule_type.name: Alert Rules
rule_type.purpose: Warn users of potential issues without blocking; user may proceed or return to fix.

mechanics.step: Same condition structure as Validation but non-blocking.
Useful for soft policy (e.g., margin warning, non-standard terms notice).

rule_type.name: Selection Rules
rule_type.purpose: Automatically add, remove, enable, disable, show, or hide options without user notification.

mechanics.step: ConfigurationRule records define automated behavior through RuleType and target-product mappings.
Filter-based actions can target multiple products at once via field matching (e.g., all products where isAccessory = true).
Ideal for auto-including mandatory accessories or hiding incompatible options.

rule_type.name: Filter Rules
rule_type.purpose: Pre-filter which products are available in a dynamic bundle before the user sees them.

mechanics.step: Applied at feature level; limits the product picker to matching criteria.
Supports Optional filter (user-initiated) and Default filter (auto-applied on load).
Implemented as REQUIRES and EXCLUDES relationships on ConfigurationRule records.

scope_options.option: Fires on the Product Configuration page (bundle configurator).
Fires on the quote line workspace.

evaluation_events.event: Evaluate when configuration page or quote line editor loads.
Evaluate after user makes a change.

rule_evaluation_control.enterprise_note: At enterprise scale, batch rule evaluations and use Redis-cached decision matrices to avoid O(n*m) rule-vs-product evaluations on every interaction.

operation_group.name: Option Constraints
operation_group.description: Intra-bundle dependency and exclusion constraints between specific options. Separate from product rules; operates at the option-pair level.

constraint_type.name: Dependency
constraint_type.purpose: When option A is selected, option B must also be selected (and vice versa for deselection).

constraint_type.name: Exclusion
constraint_type.purpose: When option A is selected, option B is automatically deselected/disabled.
constraint_type.field: Prevents incompatible option combinations within a single bundle.

operation_group.name: Product Bundling
operation_group.description: Combine products into sellable packages. Lead product (always included) plus follower products connected via ProductOption records.

bundle_type.name: Static Bundles
bundle_type.characteristic: Manually curated ProductOption records with fixed option set.
Best for stable product mixes; changes require manual add/remove.

bundle_type.name: Dynamic Bundles
bundle_type.characteristic: Filter rules auto-populate available options based on product field criteria.
New products matching filters appear automatically; discontinued ones drop out.
Filter types: Optional (user picks) vs. Default (auto-applied).

bundle_type.name: Nested Bundles
bundle_type.characteristic: A bundle option can itself be a bundle, enabling multi-level configuration.
Common for complex solutions (e.g., server → chassis → drive bay → drives).

bundle_elements.element: OptionGroup → Product link; includes quantity, pricing adjustment, default selection, and ordering fields.
Groups options logically; sets min/max selection counts; controls SelectionType.
Custom product attributes influencing configuration behavior and downstream field mapping.
Intra-bundle REQUIRES or EXCLUDES constraints between two options.

operation_group.name: Catalog and Taxonomy
operation_group.description: Organize products into hierarchies and classifications for discovery, governance, and rule scoping.

capability.name: Product Families
capability.characteristic: Top-level classification on Product; used for rule scoping, reporting, and catalog filtering.

capability.name: Categories and Hierarchies
capability.characteristic: Products associated with categories for logical grouping (e.g., Hardware → Servers → Rack-Mount).
Hierarchies allow subdivision into progressively finer groups.
Catalog browsing UI displays categories with associated products.

capability.name: Product Groups
capability.characteristic: Cross-cutting groupings independent of family (e.g., "Promotional Items," "New Releases").
Used as scope for constraint rules and recommendation targeting.

capability.name: Product Definitions
capability.characteristic: Core fields: Sku, Name, Description, ProductType, Category, Status, Configurable, Bundle.
Commercial fields: ListPrice, Currency, BillingFrequency, UnitOfMeasure.

operation_group.name: Attributes and Configuration
operation_group.description: Enable product customization and configuration without creating multiple SKUs.

capability.name: Product Attributes
capability.characteristic: Associate specifications (color, size, model, capacity) enabling customer customization.
Input types: picklist, free-form, computed/display, product reference.
Attributes can be placed within features when related to specific options.

capability.name: Attribute Groups
capability.characteristic: Organize related attributes together (e.g., "Physical Specs," "Performance Specs").
Must be associated with products to appear on configuration UI.

capability.name: Configuration Attributes
capability.characteristic: Bundle-level attributes that drive option behavior.
AppliedImmediately: controls whether changes re-evaluate rules instantly.
TargetField: maps attribute value to a field on the quote line.

capability.name: Attribute-Based Configuration (SAP / Oracle)
capability.characteristic: Configuration driven by attribute values and constraint expressions rather than explicit option lists.
Variant configuration: define characteristics and values; solver resolves valid combinations.
Supports complex BOM/engineering rules and manufacturing constraints.

capability.name: Cross-Object Field Mapping
capability.characteristic: Paired fields across objects (Product → QuoteLine, ProductOption → QuoteLine, QuoteLine → Subscription) that auto-synchronize values.
Use for propagating SLA level, discount percentage, subscription dates.
Limit count to avoid performance impact at enterprise scale.

operation_group.name: Guided Selling
operation_group.description: Dynamic, needs-based product selection. Customer or sales rep answers questions; system maps answers to recommended products or bundles.

capability.name: Guided Selling Flows
capability.characteristic: Ordered question sets (company size, industry, use case, budget).
Follow-up questions branch dynamically based on prior answers.
Output: filtered product list, recommended bundles, or auto-configured quotes.

capability.name: Needs Assessment Integration
capability.characteristic: Guided selling inputs feed into recommendation engine and filter rules.
Reduces time-to-quote for new reps; ensures consistent product selection.

operation_group.name: Product Lifecycle Management
operation_group.description: Manage products through introduction, growth, maturity, and discontinuation. Versioning model sourced from Oracle EPC and Configit CLM.

capability.name: Versioning
capability.characteristic: Draft and Released versions with unique version numbers.
Effective dates (start/end) control when a version is active.
Published versions are frozen; cloning creates new draft for modifications.
All related entities (options, rules, attributes) are cloned with the version.

capability.name: Product Introduction
capability.characteristic: New product starts as Draft; goes through review/approval gate before activation.
Staged rollout: make visible to internal users first, then selected accounts, then general availability.

capability.name: End-of-Life / Discontinuation
capability.option: Irreversible; product unavailable for all operations; historical records remain.
Reversible; blocks new quotes but preserves renewals/amendments on existing subscriptions.
Map retired product to successor SKU; auto-suggest replacement during amendments/renewals.

operation_group.name: Product Recommendations (AI-Suggested, Human-Approved)
operation_group.description: Cross-sell, upsell, substitute, and compatibility suggestions. ML models generate recommendations; product managers review and activate.

capability.name: AI Recommendation Pipeline
capability.step: ML models trained on quoting activity (line co-occurrence, win/loss, attach rates).
Models: Frequently Bought Together, Customers Also Bought, Upsell Opportunity, Substitute.
Recommendations created with confidence score in Draft status.
Auto-refresh cycle (configurable, e.g., every 15 days) regenerates suggestions.

capability.name: Human Review and Activation
capability.step: Product managers view pending recommendations in admin UI.
Filter by confidence threshold, product family, recommendation type.
Approve → Active (visible to sales), Reject → Retired, Edit → adjust target/type.
Audit trail records who approved/rejected and when.

capability.name: Rule-Based Recommendations (Manual)
capability.characteristic: Product managers manually define cross-sell/upsell mappings.
Coexist with AI-generated recommendations; manual rules take precedence on conflict.

capability.name: Account-Specific Recommendations (Zilliant)
capability.characteristic: Recommendations personalized by customer industry, purchase history, and segment.
Displayed in CPQ UI and self-service commerce portals.

operation_group.name: Pricing Association
operation_group.description: Product managers associate products with price books and price list items. The Pricing Engine bounded context owns calculation logic; this service owns the association.

capability.name: Price Books (PriceBook)
capability.characteristic: Standard Price Book: baseline prices for all products.
Custom Price Books: segment/channel-specific pricing (e.g., Partner, Enterprise, Government).
A product must have a Standard Price Book entry before appearing in custom books.

capability.name: Price Book Entries (PriceBookEntry)
capability.characteristic: Per-product price in a specific price book.
Effective dates (start/end) for time-bound pricing.
Price types: One-Time, Recurring, Usage-Based.

capability.name: Block Pricing and Volume Tiers
capability.characteristic: Define quantity-based pricing tiers on PriceBookEntry or product.
Price breaks: flat rate per tier or sliding scale.

operation_group.name: Dynamic Pricing and Discount Governance
operation_group.description: Agentic pricing layer continuously optimizes competitiveness and profitability while enforcing strict margin guardrails through autonomous governance.

capability.name: Demand-Based Dynamic Pricing
capability.characteristic: Ingest market demand signals and adjust target pricing bands in near real time.
Increase during spikes and relax during demand lulls under policy limits.

capability.name: Cost-Plus Dynamic Pricing
capability.characteristic: Track procurement and supply-chain cost shifts and auto-preserve margin floors.
Recalculate recommended price ranges when input costs fluctuate materially.

capability.name: Segmented and Performance Pricing
capability.characteristic: Tailor price recommendations by customer segment, region, CLTV, and deal velocity.
Use historical win/loss outcomes to tune conversion-vs-margin tradeoffs.

capability.name: Automated Discount Governance
capability.characteristic: Instantly evaluate requested discounts against policy matrices and approval thresholds.
Auto-approve in-policy requests; route exceptions to correct approver without manual handoffs.
Maintain immutable logs for every override and exception decision.

autonomy_model.future_state: Progressive autonomy as trust, data quality, and policy confidence increase.

operation_group.name: Feature Sets and Comparison
operation_group.description: Enable side-by-side product comparison for informed customer selection.

capability.name: Feature Sets
capability.characteristic: Configure feature dimensions (e.g., Storage, Bandwidth, Support Level) across product family.
Comparison matrix displayed during product selection or guided selling.

operation_group.name: BOM Mapping and Manufacturing Integration
operation_group.description: Map configured products to bill-of-materials structures for manufacturing/fulfillment. Sourced from Oracle CPQ Product Workbench; not native to the baseline OpenCRM CPQ model.

capability.name: BOM Mapping Rules
capability.characteristic: Define how configuration choices translate to BOM line items.
Auto-generate or manually create configuration-to-BOM mappings.
Effectivity dates control which BOM version applies.

capability.name: Product Workbench
capability.characteristic: Admin UI for managing BOM configurations, regenerating outdated mappings.
REST API for programmatic BOM management.

operation_group.name: Product Governance and Change Management
operation_group.description: Enterprise controls for product data changes: approval workflows, audit trails, role-based access, and compliance logging.

capability.name: Change Approval Workflow
capability.characteristic: Product definition changes (new product, rule change, price update) require approval before activation.
Multi-level approval chains based on change type and impact scope.
Approval states: Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Active (or Rejected).

capability.name: Audit Trail
capability.characteristic: All mutations to products, rules, bundles, and attributes are logged with user, timestamp, and before/after values.
Compliance-grade: immutable append-only log.
Queryable for governance dashboards and regulatory audits.

capability.name: Role-Based Access Control
capability.characteristic: Product Manager: full CRUD on products, rules, bundles, attributes.
Pricing Analyst: read products, manage price book entries.
Sales Admin: read-only catalog; manage guided selling flows.
Viewer: read-only catalog access.

capability.name: Critical Field Change Control (Netwrix / Conga)
capability.characteristic: Designate fields under change control (e.g., BillingFrequency, pricing tier).
Auto-generate compliance event when controlled field is modified.
Optional: block non-compliant changes until governance review.

operation_group.name: Bulk Management
operation_group.description: Scale product and attribute management for enterprise catalogs.

capability.name: Import / Export
capability.characteristic: Bulk create/update products, attributes, options, rules via Excel/CSV.
Template-based export for offline editing and re-import.
Validation on import: reject rows that violate schema or rule constraints.

capability.name: Mass Actions
capability.characteristic: Mass activate/deactivate products.
Mass update fields (e.g., change family for 500 products).
Mass clone product with options and rules.

operation_group.name: Subscription Product Management
operation_group.description: Define and manage subscription-based products for recurring revenue models. Subscription fields and amendment/renewal behavior in the OpenCRM CPQ domain model.

capability.name: Subscription Product Definition
capability.characteristic: RenewalModel: Renewable, One-Time, Evergreen.
PricingModel: Fixed Price, Percent of Total, Custom.
TermMonths: default term length in months.

capability.name: Amendment and Renewal Behavior
capability.characteristic: Products flagged as renewable generate renewal opportunity lines automatically.
Amendment quotes allow mid-term add/remove/swap of subscription components.
Product manager defines which products are amendable and renewal-eligible.

operation_group.name: Conversational Quoting and Next-Best-Action
operation_group.description: Quote creation agents assemble full compliant proposals from natural-language commands and continuously recommend next-best actions based on buyer intent signals.

capability.name: Quote Creation Agent
capability.characteristic: Accepts text or voice instructions and builds multi-line quotes autonomously.
Retrieves opportunity context, selects products, applies governed pricing, and prepares approvals.
Reduces manual quote assembly steps and accelerates time-to-quote.

capability.name: Signal-Driven Next-Best-Action
capability.characteristic: Consumes structured and unstructured signals: email, calls, content engagement, pricing page behavior.
Recommends configurations, bundles, and justification narratives tailored to buyer intent.

agentic_development_guidance.bounded_context: Product Catalog bounded context (primary owner) with integration to Configuration Engine bounded context for rule evaluation and constraint solving.

agent.name: Product Rules Agent
agent.responsibility: CRUD for configuration rules using REQUIRES, EXCLUDES, RECOMMENDS, DEFAULT, and VALIDATES types; maintain rule expressions and target-product effects.
agent.tools: Rule CRUD API, rule evaluation dry-run, batch rule import, rule dependency analyzer.

agent.name: Bundle Configuration Agent
agent.responsibility: Manage static/dynamic/nested bundles; ProductOption, ProductOptionGroup, and related ConfigurationRule records.
agent.tools: Bundle builder API, configuration rule validator, nested bundle depth checker.

agent.name: Catalog and Taxonomy Agent
agent.responsibility: Manage product definitions, families, categories, hierarchies, product groups.
agent.tools: Catalog CRUD API, hierarchy builder, bulk import/export, product search index sync.

agent.name: Attribute Agent
agent.responsibility: Manage product attributes, attribute groups, and cross-object field mappings.
agent.tools: Attribute CRUD API, attribute group association, field mapping sync validator.

agent.name: Lifecycle Agent
agent.responsibility: Product versioning, effective dates, introduction workflows, end-of-life transitions.
agent.tools: Version CRUD API, version clone, effective-date scheduler, sunset-with-replacement mapper.

agent.name: Guided Selling Agent
agent.responsibility: Design and maintain guided selling question flows; map outputs to products/bundles.
agent.tools: Flow designer API, question branching engine, output product mapper.

agent.name: Recommendation Agent
agent.responsibility: Ingest AI-generated recommendations; manage human review queue; activate/retire rules.
agent.tools: Recommendation ingestion API, review dashboard, confidence threshold configurator, audit logger.

agent.name: Governance Agent
agent.responsibility: Enforce change approval workflows, audit trail, RBAC, critical field change control.
agent.tools: Approval workflow engine, audit log query API, RBAC policy manager, compliance event emitter.

integration_points.point: Consumes rules, bundles, attributes, option constraints for real-time validation and constraint solving.
Consumes product–price book associations and block pricing tiers; does not own price calculation logic.
Receives validated configurations and resolved option sets; references product definitions.
Publishes quoting activity events; consumes recommendation suggestions for human review.

event_topics.topic: Product Catalog → Configuration Engine, Pricing Engine (new product available).
Product Catalog → Configuration Engine, Pricing Engine (definition changed).
Product Catalog → Configuration Engine, Quote Management (block new quotes).
Product Catalog → Configuration Engine (invalidate rule caches).
ML Pipeline → Recommendation Agent (new draft suggestions).
Recommendation Agent → Configuration Engine, Quote Management.
Lifecycle Agent → Configuration Engine, Pricing Engine (new version effective).
Governance Agent → affected bounded contexts (apply approved change).

metadata_and_schema_governance.description: Metadata is treated as the governance substrate for agent behavior and policy-compliant output.

controls.control: Canonical business glossary and semantic schema ownership by product/data governance.
Prompt and policy definitions versioned as JSON artifacts with approval workflow.
Grounding rules enforce brand voice, compliance language, and bias constraints.
All generated actions validated against metadata contracts before execution.

agentic_cicd_and_qa.description: CI/CD pipelines include agentic runners for schema validation, regression simulation, and safety checks before production promotion.

pipeline_capabilities.capability: RAG-driven test generation from historical UAT cases, validation failures, quote history, and audit logs.
High-volume simulation of configuration permutations and edge cases.
Containerized and orchestrated test scaling to avoid deployment bottlenecks.
Digital twin benchmark gates for accuracy, cost, speed, and safety.

agentic_cicd_and_qa.release_policy: No product rule, pricing matrix, or prompt change reaches production without automated validation gates.

self_healing_operations.description: Operations agents monitor telemetry and traces, isolate anomalies, reproduce failures in sandbox, propose patches, and validate fixes before rollout.

runtime_capabilities.capability: Anomaly detection across API latency, error rates, and configuration loop failures.
Autonomous root-cause analysis with localized remediation proposals.
Policy-based fix application: auto-apply low-risk patches or require human merge approval.
Multi-agent arbitration for objective conflicts (e.g., margin enforcement vs discount pressure).

agentic_security_model.description: Security controls are applied at the agent-tool boundary, not only network perimeter.

controls.control: Prompt-injection defenses for all untrusted inputs and retrieved content.
MCP and API tool invocations restricted by least-privilege role policies.
Behavioral monitoring for anomalous tool-use patterns and privilege escalation attempts.
Immutable audit trail for every autonomous action and approval decision.

deferred_item.name: PLM to CPQ Digital Thread
deferred_item.future_scope: Bidirectional engineering-to-sales synchronization for product structures, constraints, and approved changes with automated impact analysis on open quotes.

deferred_item.name: Multi-currency and Multi-language Catalog
deferred_item.future_scope: Regionalized catalogs, localized metadata, and currency-specific pricing governance.

required_sections.section: OpenCRM CPQ object alignment and extensions used
